mapper.sql: C.BASE_AMT, C.ALLOW_AMT, C.DEDUCT_AMT, (C.BASE_AMT + C.ALLOW_AMT - C.DEDUCT_AMT) AS NET_AMT
mapper.select:
SELECT C.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM, FROM TB_PAY_CALC C JOIN TB_EMP E ON E.EMP_NO = C.EMP_NO JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD
ORDER BY
${sortCol} C.EMP_NO
{ call SP_PAY_CALC(#{payYm, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) }
